name: Mukhota
detailed_description:
Mukhota is a 2.5D psychological mystery with elements of stealth, narrative puzzle-solving, and atmospheric storytelling.

You play as a boy drawn into a disturbing mystery surrounding a series of disappearances in his neighbourhood.
Driven by a need to prove himself, he sets out to investigate — not by chasing danger, but by studying it, recreating it, and placing himself at the centre of it.
Blending emergent systems with cinematic side-scrolling exploration, it invites players to shape outcomes through observation, deduction, and carefully timed interventions.
There are no enemies to fight — only the quiet tension of a world that changes as you act within it.

His quest for truth becomes something more uncertain. More personal.
And somewhere between memory and imagination, a story begins to unravel — one that might not be his to tell.
Set in a modern, culturally grounded environment, Mukhota challenges players to build meaning from small details, react to subtle behavior changes, and uncover patterns buried beneath routine. The more closely you observe, the more fragile the truth becomes.

Key Features

  • Psychological sandbox puzzle design
    Shape outcomes through layered interactions — not fixed solutions.

  • Narrative-driven stealth and timing
    Stay hidden, influence others, and choose when to act.

  • Multiple interpretations and endings
    Outcomes shift based on how well you perform — and how much you choose to see.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 core with 3,5 Ghz) or Intel i5-10400F (6 core with 2,9 Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX580 (8GB) or Nvidia GTX 1660 (6GB) or Intel Arc A750 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 core with 3,5 Ghz) or Intel i5-10400F (6 core with 2,9 Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon 6700xt (12GB) or Nvidia RTX 3060 TI (8GB) or Intel Arc A770 (16GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
